look: Veinweb Spider, a E-rank GKOM variant from the Veinweb Spiders family: dog-sized spider with crystal-tipped legs. Family anatomy: giant spiders with crystal-tipped legs and black vein-like silk. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: scattered small GKOM crystal clusters on shoulders and back; most of the body still natural; the crystals are black vein crystal. A golf-ball-sized GKOM core orb, cloudy amber, faint glow, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, small subtle shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils
